question.text: Which is a primary REASON to use an Offshore Fund structure?

answer.text: Tax neutrality for offshore investors; avoid double taxation on same income stream

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 4.1.1, offshore structures provide tax neutrality (BIPA) and avoid double taxation. The Trap: Avoiding SEBI isn't legally possible for Indian investment; higher fees aren't the motive. Cross-Exam Context: Core international tax planning. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Reference the specific DTAA/BIPA when advising cross-border clients.
